notes:
Phones, tablets and foldables: a new setting, Double tap for full screen (Settings > Playback and audio), chooses whether one tap or two on the small picture goes full screen. One tap is the default.

Tablets and unfolded foldables: Pause, Stop and Full screen sit together in one pill inside the Now playing box on every page (Home, Movies, Shows, Live TV and Sports) instead of over the picture, and Live TV labels what's playing as Now playing. The featured art slowly zooms, as on phones, and fades out on both sides, and Home's search bar scrolls away as you scroll.

On tablets and TVs, rows of game and team tiles fade out at an edge when there's more to scroll to, instead of being cut off.
